pack.name: GRC Notification Templates
pack.description: Email and in-app notification templates for all core GRC workflows: access requests, SoD violations, certification campaigns, firefighter alerts, risk escalations, and JML events. Supports variable substitution.
pack.author: GovernexPlus

items.name: Access Request — Pending Approval
items.description: Sent to approvers when a new access request requires their action. Includes request summary, requester details, access requested, and direct approval link.

payload.subject: Action Required: Access Request from {{requester_name}}
payload.body_html:
Dear {{approver_name}},

An access request requires your approval.

Requester:{{requester_name}} ({{requester_email}})
Access Requested:{{role_name}} in {{system_name}}
Business Justification:{{business_justification}}
Risk Level:{{risk_level}}
SLA Deadline:{{sla_deadline}}

Review and Approve/Reject

items.name: Access Request — Approved
items.description: Sent to the requester when their access request has been fully approved and provisioning is complete.

payload.subject: Your Access Request Has Been Approved — {{role_name}}
payload.body_html:
Dear {{requester_name}},

Your access request has been approved and provisioned.

Access Granted:{{role_name}} in {{system_name}}
Effective Date:{{effective_date}}
Expiry Date:{{expiry_date}}
Approved By:{{approver_name}}

Please note this access is subject to periodic review and may be revoked if no longer required.

items.name: Access Request — Rejected
items.description: Sent to the requester when their access request has been rejected, with the approver's reason.

payload.subject: Access Request Rejected — {{role_name}}
payload.body_html:
Dear {{requester_name}},

Your access request has been rejected.

Access Requested:{{role_name}} in {{system_name}}
Rejected By:{{rejector_name}}
Reason:{{rejection_reason}}

If you believe this is in error, please contact your manager or the security team.

items.name: SoD Violation — New Conflict Detected
items.description: Sent to the risk/compliance team and the user's manager when a new SoD conflict is detected. Requires prompt review and remediation or formal risk acceptance.

payload.subject: ALERT: SoD Violation Detected — {{user_name}}
payload.body_html:
A Segregation of Duties conflict has been detected and requires your immediate attention.

User:{{user_name}} ({{user_id}})
Conflict:{{conflict_name}}
Severity:{{severity}}
Conflicting Roles:{{role_list}}
Detected:{{detection_date}}

Required action: Review the conflict within 5 business days and either remediate or submit a formal risk acceptance.

View Violation Details

items.name: Certification Campaign — Review Tasks Assigned
items.description: Sent to reviewers when a new certification campaign opens and tasks are assigned to them. Includes campaign details, item count, and deadline.

payload.subject: Action Required: {{campaign_name}} — {{item_count}} items to review
payload.body_html:
Dear {{reviewer_name}},

The {{campaign_name}} certification campaign has started and you have review tasks assigned.

Campaign:{{campaign_name}}
Items to Review:{{item_count}}
Deadline:{{campaign_deadline}}

Please complete your reviews before the deadline. Incomplete reviews will be escalated to your manager.

Start Reviewing

items.name: Certification Campaign — Reminder
items.description: Reminder sent to reviewers with outstanding items as the campaign deadline approaches.

payload.subject: REMINDER: {{days_remaining}} days left — {{pending_count}} items pending in {{campaign_name}}
payload.body_html:
Dear {{reviewer_name}},

This is a reminder that you have {{pending_count}} outstanding review items in {{campaign_name}}.

Deadline: {{campaign_deadline}} ({{days_remaining}} days remaining)

Incomplete reviews will be automatically escalated to {{escalation_contact}} if not completed by the deadline.

Complete Your Reviews Now

items.name: Firefighter Session — Real-Time Alert
items.description: Immediate alert sent to the FF controller and CISO when a Firefighter session begins. Enables real-time oversight.

payload.subject: ALERT: Firefighter Session Started — {{ff_id}} by {{user_name}}
payload.body_html:
A Firefighter session has just been initiated.

Firefighter ID:{{ff_id}}
Used By:{{user_name}} ({{user_id}})
System:{{system_name}} / {{client}}
Reason Code:{{reason_code}} — {{reason_description}}
Incident Ticket:{{incident_ticket}}
Session Start:{{session_start}}
Max Duration:{{max_duration_hours}} hours

The session log will be available for review within 30 minutes of session end.

items.name: Firefighter Log Review — Action Required
items.description: Sent to the FF controller after a session ends, requesting review and sign-off of the activity log within 72 hours.

payload.subject: Action Required: Review FF Log — {{ff_id}} Session {{session_id}}
payload.body_html:
Dear {{controller_name}},

A Firefighter session has ended and requires your review within 72 hours (by {{review_deadline}}).

Firefighter ID:{{ff_id}}
Used By:{{user_name}}
Session Duration:{{duration_minutes}} minutes
Transactions Executed:{{transaction_count}}
Flagged Activities:{{flagged_count}}

Review Session Log

items.name: JML — New Joiner Access Ready
items.description: Welcome notification to new employees when their initial access provisioning is complete.

payload.subject: Welcome to {{company_name}} — Your Access is Ready
payload.body_html:
Dear {{employee_name}},

Welcome to {{company_name}}! Your system access has been provisioned based on your role: {{job_title}} in {{department}}.

Your accounts have been created in the following systems:

    {{system_list}}

Please log in and change your temporary password within 24 hours. For any access issues, contact the IT helpdesk at {{helpdesk_email}}.

items.name: JML — Offboarding Access Revoked
items.description: Confirmation sent to HR and the departing employee's manager when offboarding access revocation is complete.

payload.subject: Offboarding Complete — {{employee_name}} access revoked
payload.body_html:
This is confirmation that the offboarding process for {{employee_name}} has been completed.

Employee:{{employee_name}} ({{employee_id}})
Termination Date:{{termination_date}}
Access Revoked:{{revocation_timestamp}}
Systems Processed:{{system_count}} systems

All active sessions have been terminated and accounts disabled. Asset return status: {{asset_return_status}}.

items.name: Risk Escalation — High/Critical Risk Identified
items.description: Escalation alert sent to CISO and Compliance Officer when a high or critical risk is opened or the risk score exceeds the appetite threshold.

payload.subject: ESCALATION: {{severity}} Risk — {{risk_name}}
payload.body_html:
A {{severity}} risk has been identified that exceeds the organization's risk appetite and requires immediate attention.

Risk:{{risk_name}}
Category:{{risk_category}}
Inherent Score:{{inherent_score}}/25
Risk Owner:{{risk_owner}}
Identified:{{identification_date}}

Required action: Assign mitigation controls or submit formal risk acceptance within 5 business days.

View Risk Details

items.name: TPRM — Vendor Assessment Due
items.description: Reminder sent to the vendor relationship manager when a third-party risk assessment is due for renewal.

payload.subject: Action Required: Vendor Assessment Due — {{vendor_name}}
payload.body_html:
Dear {{manager_name}},

The third-party risk assessment for {{vendor_name}} is due for renewal.

Vendor:{{vendor_name}}
Risk Tier:{{risk_tier}}
Last Assessment:{{last_assessment_date}}
Due Date:{{due_date}}

Please initiate a new assessment or confirm the existing assessment is still valid.

Start Assessment
